name: add_product_images_storage
query: insert into storage.buckets (id, name, public, file_size_limit, allowed_mime_types) values ('product-images', 'product-images', true, 5242880, array['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp']::text[]) on conflict (id) do update set public = excluded.public, file_size_limit = excluded.file_size_limit, allowed_mime_types = excluded.allowed_mime_types; do $$ begin if not exists (select 1 from pg_policies where schemaname = 'storage' and tablename = 'objects' and policyname = 'admin_upload_product_images') then create policy "admin_upload_product_images" on storage.objects for insert to authenticated with check (bucket_id = 'product-images' and exists (select 1 from public.user_roles where user_id = auth.uid() and role = 'admin')); end if; if not exists (select 1 from pg_policies where schemaname = 'storage' and tablename = 'objects' and policyname = 'admin_update_product_images') then create policy "admin_update_product_images" on storage.objects for update to authenticated using (bucket_id = 'product-images' and exists (select 1 from public.user_roles where user_id = auth.uid() and role = 'admin')) with check (bucket_id = 'product-images' and exists (select 1 from public.user_roles where user_id = auth.uid() and role = 'admin')); end if; if not exists (select 1 from pg_policies where schemaname = 'storage' and tablename = 'objects' and policyname = 'admin_delete_product_images') then create policy "admin_delete_product_images" on storage.objects for delete to authenticated using (bucket_id = 'product-images' and exists (select 1 from public.user_roles where user_id = auth.uid() and role = 'admin')); end if; end $$;
